watches.name: RED BUMBLEBEE - Chewie_Co
watches.description: Collaborating with the talented artist Chewie and Co., Charles Berret is bringing in a new Artisan Series with intricate fineliner ink drawings. This beautiful piece blends art with time and showcasing exceptional craftsmanship at the pinnacle of and creativity. BUMBLE BEE, captures Chewie's iconic artwork with meticulous attention to detail. The fuzzy bee, a staple in Chewie's creations, takes center stage on this dial, featuring vibrant yellow hues that mimic the bumble bee's distinct coloration. It is a playful and eye-catching addition to the Artisan Series, guaranteed to make a statement on any wrist. Bumblebees represent hard work productivity and community value, that are so important to Chewie_Co. Beyond its captivating aesthetics, TITAN is an exceptional timepiece that embodies sustainability, durability, and style. The 100% recyclable titanium case ensures a lightweight yet robust construction, enhancing both comfort and longevity. This biocompatible material aligns with our commitment to reducing environmental impact while providing a timepiece that stands the test of time. With sapphire crystal and an anti-reflective coating, the dial remains easily readable in any lighting condition while receiving optimal protection against scratches and wear. The engraved titanium crown adds a touch of luxury, showcasing our dedication to craftsmanship and attention to detail. watches.name: KAZE - Desert Gold
watches.description: Kaze, meaning "wind" in Japanese, embodies the elegance and motion of a whirlwind, much like the tourbillon's French origins. This unique timepiece blends vintage charm and modern craftsmanship, creating an exquisite watch that captures the essence of time itself. Dial Inspired by vintage pocket watch dials, Kaze features a "tremblage" style dial. This intricate design reflects light in a sparkling way, with metallic silver sprinkles that add a touch of elegance and sophistication. Movement Our in house finished high-beat tourbillon movement operates at 21,600 beats per hour (bph), ensuring precision and smooth operation. With a remarkable thickness of less than 6 mm and 21 jewels, this movement is a marvel of modern engineering. Case Crafted from Grade 5 titanium, the case draws inspiration from the serene beauty of Japanese zen stacked pebbles. Contrast between a matted or high polished finish with our special case construct. Case size 39.5 mm Lug width 20mm Case thickness 9mm without crystal ,12.5mm with high domed crystal Limited Edition Kaze is a limited edition watch, with only 30 pieces available. Each watch is individually numbered, offering a unique opportunity to own a piece of horological artistry. Delivery expected in October 2026.

watches.name: HELIOS
watches.description: Charles Berret's captivating new DARTH Helios timepiece radiates style and sophistication. Inspired by the Greek god of the sun, the Helios features a vibrant orange dial that glows with a warm, yellow-hued Swiss lume in low-light conditions. Encased in a curved 316L stainless steel body, this 38mm luxury watch embodies the radiance and energy of the sun. Powered by a Swiss-made automatic movement, the Helios combines precision timekeeping with exceptional craftsmanship. The exhibition caseback allows you to admire the intricate details of the movement, including the blue screws and Genève stripes that add a touch of elegance. Newly equipped with a stainless steel bracelet, the Helios offers an extra layer of durability and versatility. Whether you're exploring the depths of the ocean or navigating the urban jungle, this sophisticated timepiece will be your constant companion, radiating confidence wherever you go. Featuring a durable sapphire crystal, the DARTH Helios is designed for both style and functionality. Experience the power of the sun on your wrist and become part of the DARTH legacy. Key Features: 38mm 316L Stainless Steel Case Swiss-made Automatic Movement Solid tungsten rotor, 68 hours power reserve Vibrant Orange Dial with Swiss Lume Exhibition Caseback Logo engraved Sapphire Crystal with Anti-Reflective Coating Stainless Steel Bracelet 5 ATM Water Resistance The DARTH Helios is a testament to Charles Berret's commitment to redefining the boundaries of modern horology.

watches.name: ASTERIA Special Edition
watches.description: ASTERIA special edition The ASTERIA Special Edition is the culmination of our relentless pursuit of perfection. We have taken into account of our backer's valuable suggestion and created this special edition and upgraded to high polished metal markers and whole new design. The ASTERIA special edition features a genuine meteorite dial, combined with a contemporary design with only high polished metal logo. The emphasis theunique and captivating texture of our meteorite dial, making each ASTERIA Special Edition a true work of art. But there's more to this limited edition than just its celestial origins. The ASTERIA Special Edition is a venture into a new design language for Charles Berret, with only 10 prototypes ever to be produced in this configuration. Yes, you read that right - only 10 fortunate individuals will have the privilege of owning this extraordinary timepiece. Our team of expert watchmakers spared no effort in ensuring that every detail of the ASTERIA Special Edition is executed flawlessly. Our logo is engraved in the center of the sapphire crystal which adds a touch of sophistication. The Swiss-made movement, tungsten rotor and impressive 68-hour power reserve, ensures precision and reliability that will stand the test of time. Join our Charles Berret Collector community with this extraordinary journey as we push the boundaries of luxury watchmaking. Back our campaign now and become a part of the exclusive circle of ASTERIA Special Edition owners.

watches.name: ASTERIA - METEORITE
watches.description: Deriving its name from the Greek mythology, ASTERIA embodies ethereal connection to the cosmos. At the heart of the ASTERIA lies a dial like no other. We have meticulously sourced a rare and mesmerizing material from the depths of space - a genuine meteorite. Each piece of this extraordinary meteorite unveils an intricate tapestry of nickel-iron crystals that have formed over countless millennia, creating in the magnificent Widmanstätten pattern. ASTERIA's meteorite dial is a testament to the celestial beauty forged over millions of years. The gaps between these celestial formations are filled with plessite, crating a mesmerizing display of cosmic artistry. Asteria is a combination of sleek metallic shine and the mysterious meteor glow. The cave-in sides of Asteria took inspiration from the spaceship. Adorned in an elegant onyx black porcelain dial and visible through a display caseback, Asteria's Swiss-made movement with a solid tungsten rotor transcends its functional purpose and exudes unparalleled aesthetic charm. If you want to hold the stars in your hand, this is your piece. watches.name: OCTAGON - 3 SLOTS - NAVY
watches.description: Perfecting watch cases with the finest lychee grain leather and suede interior, this navy blue premium watch case from Charles Berret is uniquely made to protect your favourite timepiece while adding sophistication and elegance to your collection. While lychee grain leather is highly regarded in the leather industry for its supple texture and natural beauty, it is is also incredibly strong and resistant to wear and tear, making it the perfect material for the interior lining of our watch case. This elegant, chic and secure watch case offers a truly indulgent experience for any watch enthusiast.
